observed_reality: Current ClayVM v1 serializes function parameter names but not declared parameter types into the VM module metadata.
Current compile_typed_ir intentionally rejects all non-Int parameters while allowing String returns.
Current executable_ir_adapter intentionally rejects non-Int locals and call parameters; linux.process.spawn.v0 remains typed as (Int)->Int request-id bridge.
Current product main retained the same clayvm.py and executable_ir_adapter.py blob identities while unrelated EntityOS state-symlink work advanced main.
grf.generated_reality: Directly removing the current String-parameter fail-closed guard would permit String values without binding their declared parameter type identity into the serialized ClayVM artifact.
grf.counter_reality: The existing serialized module metadata may already differ when only the declared parameter type changes, making an ABI extension unnecessary for String parameter identity.
grf.falsifier: Under a counterfactual guard bypass, serialize otherwise identical one-parameter functions differing only in declared parameter type. If the wire bytes differ, the counter-reality survives; if identical, naive guard removal is refuted.

primary_external_evidence.claim: Linux process argv is a null-pointer-terminated vector of strings; argument/environment byte accounting and E2BIG limits apply at the exec boundary.

primary_external_evidence.source: The Open Group Base Specifications, exec family
primary_external_evidence.claim: argv members are null-terminated character strings and the argv array terminates with a null pointer; ARG_MAX constrains argument/environment storage.

architecture_delta.decision: Do not relax String parameter checks on ClayVM v1. First bind parameter type identity into the canonical VM artifact ABI, then allow exact typed entry/internal-call validation. Keep Bytes as a separate canonical value class; perform explicit String-to-UTF-8 argv conversion only at the Linux interop boundary and reject embedded NUL.
architecture_delta.rollback: No production mutation was made; discard the candidate if a smaller provenance-equivalent ABI mechanism is demonstrated and passes the same discriminators.

artifact_blocker: No actually-started isolated sandbox is presently available to apply and test the canonical clayvm.py/executable_ir_adapter.py ABI patch and rebuild the exact one-file EntityOS. The current hosted EntityOS sandbox evidence observed in this go cycle failed before steps, while the local sandbox cannot clone the private product repository through direct GitHub DNS.
